action_merges.rationale: Both actions recover an empty post-tool continuation by sending the recovery nudge through the normal continuation path, and both have exact-nudge regression evidence. They are not safely equivalent: semantic-action:004c33e49d9cf153 requires and increments an explicit two-attempt budget with a no-more-nudges postcondition, while semantic-action:26186cfe5470ed34 clears a one-cycle armed state and uses a different stream-call oracle. They also come from the same episode, so workflow co-occurrence is insufficient for merging.
